dev_choice: name refuter: rival with mutual=False, shared_overrides=False, ordinary_words=False, near=0.85, legal form stripped; best dev precision of five settings (99.29% against 98.32% with no refuter) for 0.2pt recall
known_risks: CQC may record a sister company's number; key errors count as errors in every arm
exact_national needs the folded name unique on the whole register; dissolved companies stay on the file and can make a name non-unique
companies that renamed since CQC registration fail every exact arm
the test half is about the same size as dev (district split, not provider split)
name: x17_uk_ch_legal_entity
post_hoc_basis: X17 was designed after reading X16's errors (identical address overriding a distinctive name difference; registered office refuting exact names). That is why its test is on districts X17's choices never saw; X16's own districts include them, so organisation's test-half numbers are X16 numbers re-sliced, not fresh.
question: On held-out postcode districts, does an exact-name cascade with a legal-entity pack link CQC providers to their Companies House company better than X16's exact arm, does the engine add anything after a national exact pass, and does the legal-entity pack beat the organisation pack?

arms.exact_district: X16's exact arm: folded names equal and unique among companies registered in the provider's postcode district
arms.exact_national: folded names equal and unique across the whole Companies House file, wherever registered
arms.exact_national+legal_entity: the candidate: exact_national links first, then legal_entity links for providers and companies still free
arms.legal_entity: reconcile(entity='legal_entity') on the same per-district candidates as X16 (distinctive-word first pass), matches only
arms.organisation: X16's engine edges (reconcile(entity='organisation')), matches only, restricted to test districts
arms.others: exact_district+organisation, exact_district+legal_entity, exact_national+organisation are reported, not judged

rule.metrics: precision with Wilson 95% interval, recall_all (over providers whose company is in the file), recall_reachable
rule.one_to_one: every arm kept one-to-one (higher score first, ties by id); within district for engine arms, nationally for exact_national
rule.split: districts by sha256(district)[0] % 2: even = dev (used to choose the name refuter, 12,709 providers), odd = test (scored once, here)
rule.truth: the Companies House number CQC records for the provider; providers whose number is not in the file are not evaluable

verdict.q1: cascade precision >= exact_district precision - 0.002, Wilson lower >= 0.99, recall_all >= exact_district recall_all + 0.05
verdict.q2: cascade recall_all >= exact_national recall_all + 0.005 and cascade precision >= exact_national precision - 0.002 (the engine earns its place after the national exact pass)
verdict.q3: legal_entity precision >= organisation precision + 0.003 and legal_entity recall_all >= organisation recall_all

x16_disclosure: X16's recall bound (engine >= exact + 10pt) could not be met by any in-district arm: the in-district reachable ceiling was ~71% of providers against a bar of 79.7%. The bound was set without computing that ceiling. X16's verdict stands; the bound was unattainable by construction, which X16 did not say.
